lies.text: Everyone in my office earned their job on merit alone.
lies.reaction: The ranking says someone else earned that job.

lies.text: My relatives received no special treatment. None at all.
Nobody on my payroll is paid for doing nothing.
My office has nothing to hide from an audit.
lies.reaction: Hiring files and payroll together. An audit would find all of it.
lies.shortcut_reaction: The leaked email names them all. No audit needed.

intro: My family is my business. And my business is nobody's business.
